claims.text: The hotel is in the Orchard Road area, Singapore's shopping and entertainment district.

findings.quote: Nestled in the Orchard Road area, Singapore’s iconic shopping and entertainment district

claims.text: The hotel has two wings: the Grand Wing, a Grand Living Room where guests convene and celebrate, and the Terrace Wing, an urban oasis and wellness haven with lush landscaping and a cascading waterfall.

findings.quote: both Grand Wing—a Grand Living Room where guests convene and celebrate—and Terrace Wing, an urban oasis and wellness haven steps from the bustling streets with lush landscaping and a cascading waterfall

claims.text: Grand Wing rooms have contemporary interiors with accents that pay homage to Singapore's heritage, while Terrace Wing rooms are nature-inspired with wooden furnishings and marble-green tones.

findings.quote: In the Grand Wing, contemporary interiors are enriched with accents that pay homage to Singapore’s heritage, while the Terrace Wing offers a nature‑inspired stay with wooden furnishings and marble‑green tones
findings.note: Room design of both wings matches.

claims.text: The interiors were redesigned under design director Yohei Akao of Strickland, with landscape architects Grant Associates.

findings.quote: resurrected under the care of design director Yohei Akao of the award-winning design firm Strickland, and renowned landscape architects Grant Associates
findings.note: Designer, firm and landscape architects match.

claims.text: The lobby is marbled, with wooden columns and a spiral staircase.

findings.quote: The hotel’s cavernous marbled lobby, with its wooden columns and iconic spiral staircase

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a full kitchen with a separate butler entrance, a dining area, a powder room, an office and a private bedroom.

findings.quote: complete with a full kitchen with separate butler entrance, dining area, powder room, office, and private bedroom

claims.text: The outdoor pools include a semi-Olympic-sized pool for laps and a hydro-massage saltwater pool.

findings.quote: Enhance your fitness by swimming laps in the semi-Olympic-sized pool or unwind with a massage in the hydro-massage saltwater pool.
findings.note: Both pools named; described as outdoor aquatic facilities.

claims.text: Damai, meaning peace in Malay, is the hotel's wellness haven and spa.

findings.quote: Damai, meaning "peace" in Malay, is a reimagined wellness haven in Grand Hyatt Singapore

claims.text: The Grand Club on Level 1M offers breakfast options, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail experience.

findings.quote: Experience the exclusive amenities of the new Grand Club on Level 1M in an intimate atmosphere, including breakfast options, all-day refreshments, and an evening cocktail experience.

claims.text: StraitsKitchen is a halal-certified buffet of Singaporean dishes in a marketplace setting.

findings.quote: Uniquely Singaporean, savour authentic and refined local dishes in a vibrant marketplace setting. Celebrating Singapore’s diverse food culture, the halal-certified buffet is Muslim-friendly
findings.note: Halal buffet, Singaporean dishes, marketplace setting.

claims.text: Room daybeds can be converted to beds that sleep two children under 12.

findings.quote: The daybeds in the rooms can be converted to beds that sleep two kids below the age of 12.

claims.text: The hotel has its own bespoke water bottling plant.

findings.quote: it now has its own bespoke water bottling plant

claims.text: The Garden Oasis on the fifth floor has winding paths, banyan trees and butterflies.

findings.quote: the lush Garden Oasis on the fifth floor, with its winding paths, banyan trees, and butterflies

claims.text: The Garden Oasis is part of the Orchard Road Butterfly Trail, a green-corridor initiative developed with the national parks board and the Nature Society Singapore.

findings.quote: It’s part of the Orchard Road Butterfly Trail, a green-corridor initiative developed in partnership with the national parks board and the Nature Society Singapore

claims.text: Damai House has a mind-body-therapy wall and hosts functional movement classes, free for guests, from vertical yoga to tai chi.

findings.quote: Damai House, with its mind-body-therapy wall, is a space for functional movement classes—that are free for guests—from vertical yoga to tai chi.

claims.text: Damai Spa's signature Recovery treatment, developed in-house, combines heat therapy, light therapy and acupressure massage.

findings.quote: the signature, science-backed Recovery treatment, developed in-house, that combines advanced heat therapy, light therapy, and acupressure massages

claims.text: The Garden Studio is a studio-styled room with a high ceiling and direct access to the Terrace Wing gardens.

findings.quote: rejuvenating studio-styled guestroom with high ceiling and direct access to the tranquil Terrace Wing gardens

claims.text: The streets around the hotel are busy with fashionable shoppers and tourists.

findings.quote: The streets swirl with fashionable folk and tourists.

claims.text: The spa and fitness center are open to non-guests.

findings.quote: The sprawling spa and fitness center, which is open to non-guests

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
